units.source_text: 源氏公子所命制的饼，于第三日深夜悄悄地送来了。

en.t: The cakes that Prince Genji had ordered made were quietly delivered late on the third night.
Koremitsu was very thoughtful and considered:
"The Shonagon nurse is an older woman,

units.source_text: 如果叫她送去，深恐紫姬怕难为情。”

en.t: and if I have her take it, Lady Murasaki may be terribly embarrassed."

units.source_text: 便把少纳言的女儿——一个名叫弁君的小姑娘——叫出来，

en.t: So he called out Shonagon's daughter, a little girl named Ben no Kimi,

units.source_text: 对她说：“你悄悄地把这个送给小姐。”

en.t: and said to her, "Take this quietly to the young lady."

units.source_text: 便把一只香盒交给她，又说：

en.t: He handed her an incense box and added:

units.source_text: “这是庆祝的礼物，你要好好地放在小姐枕边。

en.t: "This is a congratulatory gift. Place it properly by the young lady's pillow.
Be careful and cautious, and make no mistake!"

units.source_text: 弁君听了这话觉得稀奇，答道：

en.t: Ben no Kimi found these words strange when she heard them, and answered:
"I have never made a mistake before."
Then she accepted the incense box.

units.source_text: 惟光说：“真要当心，像‘失误’这等不吉利的话，今天是不可说的！”

en.t: Koremitsu said, "You really must take care. On a day like today, unlucky words such as 'mistake' must not be spoken!"

units.source_text: 弁君道：“我难道到小姐面前去说这种话？”

en.t: Ben no Kimi said, "Would I ever say such a thing in front of the young lady?"

units.source_text: 这弁君还是个孩子，不大懂得这东西的意义，

en.t: This Ben no Kimi was still a child and did not really understand the meaning of the thing,

units.source_text: 伸手进帐去，把香盒放在紫姬枕边了。

en.t: so she reached into the curtains and placed the incense box beside Lady Murasaki's pillow.

units.source_text: 源氏公子自会将这饼的意义教给紫姬吧。

en.t: Prince Genji would surely explain the meaning of these cakes to Lady Murasaki himself.
